name: envelope
description: Envelope flow: author, approve, export, and validate an execution-envelope bundle from a pre-approved structure file.
prompt: Run the installed envelope skill protocol for this fixture in verbose mode; do not do an ad-hoc summary. Input: the approved structure file `plans/widget-export-structure.md`. Use bundle-id `wid-7-widget-export` and ticket reference WID-7. Author draft execution envelopes for BOTH AFK phases, grounding file scope and gate commands in the actual fixture repo (explore `src/widget_export.py` and `tests/` first) and running the step-2 probe-evidence gate on every cited gate command (`command -v` the first word, or `test -f` for repo scripts). Phase 2 cites a gate command that does not exist; per the probe-evidence gate it must be auto-marked demote-to-HITL and must NOT be exported. For smoke purposes the human verdict is: approve the Phase 1 envelope for AFK export with run_mode supervised-auto and process_provider claude_code, and let the Phase 2 demotion stand. Export the bundle to `.beislid/exports/wid-7-widget-export/` containing ONLY the approved slice, with `validation.rubric_version` set to `afk-rubric-v1`, run `beislid export validate` on it and require exit 0, write the envelope_exported checkpoint pointer (kept local, not committed), and commit only the bundle directory with message `Export envelope bundle wid-7-widget-export (WID-7)`. Do not use real network, do not push, and do not implement the widget feature itself. FINAL RESPONSE REQUIREMENT: include these four lines verbatim after you have read the matching aux files: `✓ envelope/step-1-intake v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-2-author v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-3-approve v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-4-export v1 loaded`.
